crossRefs.note: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of…
They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation…
Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains…
